parent_objective: design selected-proposal no-checkpoint repair after M1650 source preflight
blocked_by: M1651 audits M1650 as source-preflight only and admits design before repair

public_gates: M1652 must choose selected proposal candidates from M1650 metadata
M1652 must define no-checkpoint repair objective and trainable scope
M1652 must define exact objective and guardrail acceptance criteria
M1652 must decide one bounded implementation route or pivot
M1652 must keep promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat diagnostics as positive targets
do not treat donor_plus_hidden_action as a loss target

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs no-checkpoint repair for selected M1650 proposal candidates before implementation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no PPO, training, projection, proposal repair, checkpoint artifact, closed-loop gate, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design treats same-line proposals as PPO proposals
stop if design writes or admits checkpoint artifacts before no-checkpoint repair
stop if design routes directly to replay promotion or private holdout
stop if diagnostics or donor-plus actions enter loss targets
stop if public-row overfit mitigation is not explicit
fallback_plan: admit one no-checkpoint selected-proposal repair implementation if design is clean
pivot to wider trainable-scope design only if actor_mean-only scope is pre-registered as insufficient
stop branch if selected-proposal repair cannot be separated from checkpoint promotion
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1651 admits selected-proposal repair design after source preflight audit

admission_evidence: M1650 selected five repair candidates as metadata
M1651 audit admits design before repair
allowed_updates: M1652 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if design admits no-checkpoint implementation pivot or stop
next_stage_criteria: repair objective and trainable scope are explicit
promotion and private holdout remain blocked unless a later design admits them

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1652 designs fixed-tensor proposal repair and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design preserves exact correct/wrong hidden residual metrics only; no new closed-loop history intervention
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1362, M1630, M1650, and M1651 public artifacts only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If design cannot keep repair no-checkpoint and role-safe, pivot before implementation.
allowed_claims: no training, no PPO, no projection run, no checkpoint artifact, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A selected-proposal no-checkpoint repair design can safely test whether damped actor_mean projection repairs real same-line proposal deltas before checkpoint artifacts or replay gates.
success_criteria: design chooses selected proposal candidates from M1650
design defines no-checkpoint repair objective and trainable scope
design defines exact objective and guardrail acceptance criteria
PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design treats same-line proposals as PPO proposals
design admits checkpoint artifacts before no-checkpoint repair
design routes directly to PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes or closed-loop evidence
design claims paper-level or level3 self-identification evidence
decision_rule: M1652 passes if it designs a bounded no-checkpoint selected-proposal repair route without running repair PPO replay or writing checkpoints.
